remarks: Welcome to 346 Woodward Avenue—a beautifully maintained, turn-key 3-unit property situated in one of Buffalo’s most desirable historic neighborhoods, just minutes from Delaware Park, the Buffalo Zoo, and Frank Lloyd Wright’s iconic Darwin Martin House! Each spacious unit offers classic architectural charm alongside extensive high-ticket capital improvements, making this an ideal opportunity for investors or owner-occupants looking to live in one unit while collecting strong rental income. The first-floor unit features 2 bedrooms, a formal dining room, a walk-through butler’s pantry, a new dishwasher, a new hot water tank, and French doors leading to a large open porch; it is currently leased through March 2027 with exceptional tenants who would love to remain. The second-floor unit mirrors the first-floor layout with extensive interior updates and sits vacant, making it move-in ready for a new owner or market-rate tenant. The third-floor unit boasts 2 bedrooms, a comfortable living area, and distinctive Palladian windows, occupied since October 2025 by great tenants who also wish to stay. All units include a stove and refrigerator, with a shared washer and dryer in the basement and convenient off-street parking. Massive recent upgrades provide complete peace of mind, including a full tear-off roof (2025), new main sewer line (2025), upgraded electrical service and panel (2025), fresh interior flooring/paint (2024–2025), and a complete interior, exterior, and windows painting refresh in July 2026. Per seller request, highest and best offers only—offers will be reviewed as received, so don't miss this incredible turn-key gem!
